title: Sreality.cz Scraper
description: Extract recommended or filtered real-estate listings from Sreality.cz with keyword, location, sorting, category, and price controls.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Recommended listings page URL. Keep the default value unless Sreality changes the route.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional text to search in Sreality listings.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional Czech location name such as Brno or Praha. The location is resolved before listings are collected.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: Optional listing order. Set a value to use filtered search mode.

offer_type.title: Offer type
offer_type.description: Optional offer type: 1 for sale or 2 for rent.

category_main.title: Main category ID
category_main.description: Optional Sreality main category ID for filtered search mode.

price_from.title: Minimum price
price_from.description: Optional minimum price in the listing currency, normally CZK.

price_to.title: Maximum price
price_to.description: Optional maximum price in the listing currency, normally CZK.

results_wanted.title: Maximum results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of listings to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for paginated API requests.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Choose whether to use Apify Proxy or connect directly. Proxy is disabled by default.
